title: Local analytic Einstein metrics from free curvature data in four dimensions
description: This preprint reconstructs marked holomorphic Einstein metric germs in four dimensions from two complete free chiral curvature records satisfying a factorial growth bound, for every prescribed cosmological constant. It proves uniform nonlinear coefficient estimates, convergent record flows, direct radial Jacobi realization, holomorphic dependence, point and full spin-frame comparisons, and the Lorentz real form. The deposit includes the paper, Markdown and TeX sources, and selected finite exact Kasner and free-record checks, independent metric witnesses with convention controls, and separately classified numerical diagnostics, with code, inputs, environment and saved results. Those checks are not an all-order formal proof. AI use is disclosed in the manuscript.
